headlines.title: The Bet Fortinet Holders Made Before A 138% Jump
headlines.summary: If Fortinet sat on your watchlist instead of in your portfolio, the outcome over this stretch may feel painful to look at. Investors who held Fortinet from the start of the year are up 137.5%, including dividends. That leap invites a harder question. What, if anything, in early 2026 could have pointed to this sort of payoff, particularly the assumption that digital transformation would keep pushing clients toward integrated cybersecurity platforms rather than piecemeal tools?

headlines.title: Fortinet (FTNT) Could Be 46% Above Fair Value On Its AI Security Launch
headlines.summary: Fortinet (FTNT) is back in focus after launching its FortiGuard Inline AI Security Service, a cloud-delivered add-on for FortiGate customers that targets AI-specific threats and data exposure using infrastructure clients already run. Recent trading has reflected that story. Fortinet’s share price is up 1.86% over the last day and 6.90% across the past week, with a 22.24% 90 day share price return and a 135.40% year to date share price gain contributing to a 114.

headlines.title: Fortinet Expands Unified SASE to Simplify Microbranch Security
headlines.summary: FortiLink SASE service brings cloud-delivered security and centralized management to wired and wireless devicesSUNNYVALE, Calif., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fortinet® (NASDAQ: FTNT), the global cybersecurity leader driving the convergence of networking and security, today announced the FortiLink SASE Service, giving organizations a simpler way to secure small branch office, remote facilities, and other distributed locations without requiring a dedicated on-site firewall.

headlines.title: What Fortinet (FTNT)'s Atos Partnership Expansion Means For Shareholders
headlines.summary: Atos recently announced an expansion of its long running partnership with Fortinet into a global engagement model, combining Fortinet security technologies with Atos managed cybersecurity, consulting and integration services across hybrid and multi cloud environments.

headlines.title: Fortinet Stock Before Q3 Earnings: Buy Now or Wait for Results?
headlines.summary: FTNT heads into Q3 earnings with strong SASE Firewall demand, AI-security expansion and buybacks, but premium valuation and margin pressures raise questions.

description: Fortinet, Inc. provides cybersecurity and convergence of networking and security solutions worldwide. The company offers FortiOS, a unified operating system designed to address cybersecurity threats; FortiASIC application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC)-based security processing units; FortiCloud, a private cloud software as a service platform; FortiAI, which provides a dual-layered defense across the Fortinet Security Fabric; FortiEndpoint, which converges secure connectivity, endpoint protection, and capabilities into a single agent; and OT Security, which protect the engineered systems that underpin infrastructure and supply chains. It also provides secure networking solutions that focus on the convergence of networking and security; network firewall solutions comprising FortiGate data centers, hyperscale, and distributed firewalls; wireless local area network solutions; and secure connectivity solutions. In addition, the company offers the Fortinet Unified Secure Access Service Edge solutions that include firewall, software-defined wide-area network, secure web gateway, cloud access services broker, data loss prevention, and zero trust network access; and web application firewalls, cloud network security with virtualized firewalls, cloud-native firewalls, cloud-native application protection, and code security. Further, it provides AI-driven security operation solutions, which include a suite of cybersecurity solutions, as well as FortiEDR, FortiXDR, FortiNDR, FortiSandbox, FortiDeceptor, FortiDLP, and FortiRecon. Additionally, the company offers FortiGuard Labs, a cybersecurity threat intelligence and research organization; FortiGuard and Other Security Services, a suite of AI-powered security capabilities that consists of FortiGuard application, content, device, NOC/SOC, and web security services; and FortiCare technical support services. Fortinet, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.
